bluetooth_confirm.title: Govee {model}
bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up the Govee {model} found via Bluetooth?

data_description.address: The 12-digit Bluetooth address printed by the device or shown by a BLE scanner.
data_description.model: The model printed on the device. A conflicting supported model advertised at this address is rejected.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Govee model
reconfigure.description: Select the exact model advertised by this device. The config entry and entity identity are preserved.

h6102_firmware.title: Experimental H6102 protocol context
h6102_firmware.description: Pact is normally read from Bluetooth advertisements. If it is missing, select a Pact only when identified with the maintainer using device evidence. Firmware alone cannot identify Pact. Unknown context permits power, brightness and identity reads. Observed Bluetooth context takes precedence.

data_description.h6102_app_firmware: Use the exact value shown by Govee Home, for example 1.03.01. Leave blank to store no firmware context.
data_description.h6102_app_hardware: Use the exact value shown by Govee Home, for example 1.00.03. Leave blank to store no hardware context.

error.invalid_address: Enter a valid 12-digit BLE MAC address.
error.invalid_firmware: Enter the exact dotted-decimal software version shown by Govee Home, for example 1.03.01.
error.invalid_hardware: Enter the exact dotted-decimal hardware version shown by Govee Home, for example 1.00.03.
error.invalid_pact: Select a known Pact or leave it automatic.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the device.
error.model_mismatch: The device at this address advertises a different supported model.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while validating the device.

abort.no_options: This model has no configurable Effect Studio options
abort.not_supported: This device is not a supported Govee model

invalid_segments.message: Select at least one valid segment.

camera_absent.message: Video mode is unavailable because the camera is absent. Connect the camera and try again.

camera_incompatible.message: Video mode is unavailable because the connected camera is incompatible.

invalid_control_request.message: The requested control settings are invalid or unsupported.

invalid_custom_effect.message: The saved effect is invalid or unavailable.

invalid_effect_target.message: {entity_id} is not a Govee BLE light.

effect_permission_denied.message: You are not allowed to control {entity_id}.

effect_apply_failed.message: The saved effect could not be applied.

music_mode_replaced.title: Music mode select replaced
music_mode_replaced.description: The select {old} has been removed. Choose a music mode from the light's effect list instead, and update any automations or scripts that used the old select.

unsupported_model.title: Unsupported Govee model
unsupported_model.description: This config entry identifies model "{model}", which this integration cannot safely control. Reconfigure the device with a supported model.

paint_segments.name: Paint segments
paint_segments.description: Paint one or more color groups onto supported addressable segments.

groups.name: Groups
groups.description: List of {segments: [1-15], rgb_color: [R, G, B]} groups; each color is sent as one packet.

rgb_scale.name: RGB scale
rgb_scale.description: Absolute percentage of the supplied RGB colours. Zero paints black without switching power off.

set_segment_color.name: Set segment color
set_segment_color.description: Set a single color on the given segments (1-15).

set_segment_brightness.name: Set segment brightness
set_segment_brightness.description: Set brightness on the given segments (1-15).

apply_custom_effect.name: Apply custom effect
apply_custom_effect.description: Apply a saved custom effect through a supported Govee light entity.

effect.name: Effect
effect.description: Name of the saved custom effect.

effect_id.name: Effect ID
effect_id.description: Stable ID of the saved custom effect. Use either Effect or Effect ID.

diy_code.name: Disposable DIY code
diy_code.description: Code of the currently selected disposable DIY item. Required for H6179 DIY effects.

init.title: Device options
init.description: Choose the BLE connection mode and, when available, which Effect Studio categories appear in the Studio and on the light entity.

data.prefix_effect_names: Prefix effects with their category (e.g., "Scene: Aurora")

data_description.connection_mode: Release disconnects after use so the Govee app can connect. Hold keeps the BLE connection open and may prevent the app from connecting.
